content.title: UMBC vs. Howard: How to watch NCAA First Four March Madness game live for free today
content.text: If you purchase a product through a link on our site, we may receive compensation.DAYTON, Ohio -- It’s that time of the year, where teams from all over the country give it their all to further extend the opportunity of winning a national championship.Today – Tuesday, March 17 – marks the official start of March Madness, the NCAA’s men’s basketball tournament. The tourney kicks off with the First Four games, play-ins where the winner goes on to the round of 64.In the first matchup, No. 16 seed UMBC Retrievers play the No. 16 seed Howard Bison; the game tips off at 6:40 p.m. Eastern on truTV.If you’ve cut ties with your cable provider, you can still tune in to tonight’s game. Several streaming services will broadcast the game live, including DIRECTV (free trial) and Sling (promotional offers as low as $4.99).Streameast alternativesAll columns visible (no scrolling needed)The winner of this game between No. 16 seeds will face No. 1-seeded Michigan in the first round.What is truTV?TruTV is one of several cable television channels owned by Warner Bros. Discovery and broadcasts select TNT Sports events throughout the year.It’s famously known for carrying the NCAA Tournament as part of March Madness. There are 12 games airing on TruTV during this year’s tournament.TruTV typically broadcasts comedies, docusoaps and reality shows.UMBC outlookWhen you think about the UMBC Retrievers, you think about 2018. That year, the team became the first-ever No. 16 seed to defeat a No. 1 seed in the men’s tournament, beating Virginia.Their run that year ended in the second round, but they’re back in full force to look about making another run.The winners of the America East Conference, UMBC is alright offensively as they average 76.2 points per game.But their strength is on the other side of the ball, ranking 29th in points allowed (67.0) while showing defensive tenacity. UMBC players to watch Jah’Likai KingComing off a scoreless performance in the America East championship, UMBC will need King to bring his game come Tuesday night. King leads the team in scoring (13.9) with a solid 41.5% shooting rate.DJ ArmstrongArmstrong has been a sharpshooter for UMBC this year, and led the America East Conference in 3-point percentage (42.0%).Howard outlookUnlike UMBC, the Howard Bison have yet to win a game come NCAA Tournament time.This is their fifth appearance in program history, and most of the previous appearances ended in blowouts in the first round. Howard last made the big dance in 2024, losing by three points to Wagner.But in similar fashion to UMBC, the Howard Bison have defensive prowess. They rank 40th in points allowed (67.8) and 13th in defensive rating (96.5).Howard players to watch Bryce HarrisAn all-around player for the Bison, Harris leads the team in points (17.1), and led the Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference in both rebounds (6.9) and field goal percentage (43.8%).Cam GillusIf Gillus can find a way to leave his mark in this game, as he has all season with nearly 11 points and 5 assists to his name, the Bison will be alright.Watch No. 16 UMBC vs. No. 16 Howard for free on DIRECTVWho is announcing No. 16 UMBC vs. No. 16 Howard? The game on TruTV will be called by Jordan Kent and Jim Spanarkel, with Jenny Dell on the sidelines.What are the latest odds for No. 16 UMBC vs. No. 16 Howard?
